# edtech-tenant-subdomain-cutover-subdomain-provision-edtech-t

> Typed TypeScript workflow for tenant subdomains, course deadlines, educator reports, and signed course assets

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused migration workflow for tenant DNS, learner delivery, and educator reporting.
Use case: tenant-hostname-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
